messages:
ana: Quick triage note 1: ran a small AB for reranker-v2 (PTQ int8) comparing 'primed-v1' vs raw queries. mixed signals: Knowledge corpus NDCG up, Support MRR down. Need a short action plan.

chris: Paste the numbers and holdout?

ana: holdout=2026-04-20 stratified, n=4k, seed=9. Snapshot:

```
corpus  | arm      | ndcg@10 | mrr
kb      | raw      | 0.718   | 0.479
kb      | primed   | 0.731   | 0.474
support | raw      | 0.659   | 0.402
support | primed   | 0.646   | 0.388
```

leo: Sounds like tokenization boundary + PTQ noise. Priming helps ambiguous kb queries but causes token merges on short support queries; PTQ amplifies tiny score deltas -> tie flips.

chris: Proposed quick steps:
- run paired eval with --strip-html to isolate doc-formatting effect
- rerun PTQ calibration with seeds [7,19] to check quant stability
- emit per-query token diffs and delta histograms (--emit-token-diff --emit-deltas)
- add measurement-only deterministic fallback tie-breaker (ranker.tie_mode=doc_id)

ana: command I used:
```
./eval_rerank --model models/ranker-v2-int8.ptq \
  --holdout s3://bench/holdouts/2026-04-20.json \
  --priming templates/primed-v1.json \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 9 --samples 4000 \
  --emit-token-diff --out s3://bench/artifacts/7077777777_ab.json
```

ci-bot: Job 7077777785 started: eval_rerank (primed vs raw, samples=4000).

leo: Also try a punctuation-safe prefix ("Query:\n") and a zero-width-space variant to prevent merges. After runs, compute per-slice effect matrix keyed by (corpus, query_len, html_noise) with columns ndcg_delta,mrr_delta,tie_rate_delta.

ana: will queue those and post artifacts. tag me for rollout decision matrix - if kb-only wins, we can enable priming via corpus routing rather than global. :white_check_mark:
